saw_lines: Lighting is bought room by room, and buyers picture a fixture on their own wall before they commit.
So the sale is won or lost in the first frame, where the buyer decides whether this fixture fits their room.
Your site shows 2,400+ reviews, yet 0 of 28 ads carry a proof number. Print 2,400+ reviews on the creative and open two ads with a review quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 15 Oct 2026
points: Your site shows 2,400+ reviews, yet 0 of 28 ads carry a proof number, so a cold buyer clicks with nothing to trust. Print 2,400+ reviews on the creative and open two ads with a review quote about the fixture.
Your site offers 10% off for signing up, yet only 1 of 11 ads mention any discount, so new buyers have no reason to act. Open three new ads with the 10% sign-up offer and print it on the creative.

5 of your 11 copy ads open on the same generic home line, so nearly half of your copy repeats one pitch. Test two new angles, Kendall’s dimmer and the Terri outdoor sconces, against it in three ads each.

Your site promotes free shipping, yet 0 of 28 ads mention shipping or delivery, so a first time buyer leaves the ad to find out. Answer it in the first line of new ads, naming free shipping on all orders.
